text: {"subject":"Authorization increase request for claim C019361 (AUTH10492)","body":"Hello, claim C019361 for patient PT0039 (date of service 2026-10-22, service code S5125) bills 9 units, but authorization AUTH10492 has only 2 of 40 units remaining.
